title: Lambu the Giraffe Reaches the Sky | Manipuri kids song, nursery rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
Meet Lambu the tall giraffe, who stretches up high to catch a floating balloon in the sky!
This fun song teaches kids about reaching for their dreams and never giving up.
Sing along and dance with Lambu, the happiest giraffe in the whole wide world!
